TM105.title: Introduction to Programming
TM105.description: This module is an introductory level programming module and it is meant to provide basic foundation in computer programming to students. Students will learn how to develop solutions (algorithms) using pseudocode to solve simple problems. Thereafter, they will learn how to implement these solutions using a programming language (Java). This module serves as foundation for second level programming modules.

Students will learn how to develop solutions (algorithms) using pseudocode to solve problems. Thereafter, students will learn how to implement these solutions using a programming language (Python). This module serves as the foundation for higher-level modules.

TM351.title: Data management and analysis
TM351.description: Data management and analysis (TM351) gives an overview of the concepts, techniques and tools of modern data management and analysis. It addresses traditional data-management concepts together with the increasingly important area of data analytics and prepares students to work with evolving data-management requirements.

BUS101.description: BUS101 Introduction to Math for Business is a level 4 common introductory module for all tracks, rationale to provide students with sound knowledge on business related calculations such as interest, profit, payroll, etc. This course will provide students with the required technical skills and business knowledge to prepare them along with all other common level 4 modules for more advanced knowledge and skills needed for next level of discipline.

FIN301-F.description: The module develops understanding of financial and securities markets, including derivatives, options, bonds, warrants and convertibles, yield curves and term structures of interest rates, currency exchange rates, portfolio risk and diversification, risk and return, and international portfolio diversification.

EL330.title: Teaching English as a Foreign Language
EL330.description: This practical module links recent research on teaching and learning English to classroom methodology. It covers English-language teaching approaches, lesson planning, classroom management, assessment, and ongoing professional development for prospective teachers of English as a foreign language.
